children: According to Wallstreetcn, Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong said on September 24 that China and the United States held their first dialogue on artificial intelligence under the China-U.S. economic and trade consultation mechanism. He said the two countries' economic and trade teams recently held the eighth round of consultations in the United States and reached multiple consensuses after candid, in-depth, and constructive exchanges on issues of mutual concern, guided by the important consensus of the two heads of state, and China will maintain close communication with the U.S. on follow-up work under the mechanism.

title: China, U.S. Hold First AI Dialogue in Trade Talks
